key_insight: G2Rec unifies graph-based user co-engagement modeling with semantic tokenization to build more holistic and semantically grounded user interest contexts for generative recommendation.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets industrial-scale recommender systems by improving sequence modeling while addressing scalability and weak supervision issues in user-interest representation.
method: Builds distributed user-interest context from holistic graph-based co-engagement signals.
Tokenizes item semantics with explicit structure to produce more accurate semantic representations.
Combines the two into a scalable generative recommendation pipeline without requiring ground-truth user interests.
evidence_signal: The paper reports extensive experiments on public datasets and online deployment across product surfaces, showing superiority over existing methods.
watch_item: Graph-based context modeling and tokenization may increase system complexity, so deployment cost and latency should be carefully validated at scale.
paper_title: Structuring and Tokenizing Distributed User Interest Context for Generative Recommendation
